description: L070501 - Tratto di linea della rete di distribuzione del gas (Comune di Milano - DBT 2012 - DATASET) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportale.comune.milano.it. Information layer of Topographic DataBase, DBT 2012 of the Municipality of Milan, flight March 2012, nominal return scale 1:1000. Pipeline used for the remote transport of natural gas. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "L070501 — Line route of the gas distribution network (Municipality of Milan — DBT 2012 — DATASET)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include DBT, DBGT, calore, database, riscaldamento, opendata. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
